crossRefs.note: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who…

translations.web: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that Yahweh had shown me.
translations.bsb: I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.
translations.kjv: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed
translations.asv: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Jehovah had showed me.
